chunks: Yunus, from Zur'ah, from Sama'ah, who said:

I asked him about false witnesses. He said: He said, "They are flogged with a discretionary hadd for which there is no fixed amount, and that is up to the Imam, and they are paraded about until the people come to know them."

key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the Imam, the authority responsible for determining the punishment
key_terms.شُهُودِ الزُّورِ: false witnesses; those who testify untruthfully
key_terms.لَيْسَ لَهُ وَقْتٌ: having no fixed limit or specified amount
key_terms.يَعْرِفَهُمُ النَّاسُ: the people come to know and recognize them

ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for false witnesses in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning those who bear false witness. It states that their punishment is not fixed to a specific amount, but is left to the discretion of the Imam, and that they are publicly exposed so that people recognize them.
